messages:
maria: Quick kickoff thread for NorthStar Health POC — want alignment before Wed 10am PT call. High-level asks: golden dataset + seed prompts, scoring rubric & regression gates, pricing cap for a 90d trial, and security/legal blockers. CC @kevin @ashley @sam
kevin: timeline? customer expects a go/no-go decision in ~3 weeks. we need tight milestones.
ashley: I can own the goldenset curation. ask from my side: we need sample customer prompts + 2 labelled GT outputs per prompt. propose 25 seed prompts per use case (they have 2). ~5 golden truth refs per prompt if possible.
sam: pricing question — finance says we can offer a discounted Dedicated trial but only if we get a 10k GPU-hour commit. can we reduce that with aggressive batching/quantization?
oliver: ops note — Dedicated trial requires SOC2 evidence, KMS integration, and VPC peering. that adds ~1 week setup. flagging as an infra blocker unless we do hosted with strict data controls.
anna: legal: I will review SOW draft. need explicit data-handling + deletion clause and IP carveouts. I also want clarity on telemetry retention for the eval harness.
maria: For the eval harness I suggest this initial weighting: accuracy 60%, factuality 20%, safety 20%. Regression gates: fail the rollout if accuracy drops >4% vs goldenset OR we see any safety regression (safety failure rate increase >0).
kevin: customer specifically cares about triage accuracy and hallucination rate. we should add a per-case threshold for hallucinations (max 2% on goldenset).
ashley: Agree. Proposed scoring snippet (will embed into harness):
```
scoring = {
  "accuracy": {"weight": 0.6, "threshold_fail_drop_pct": 4},
  "factuality": {"weight": 0.2, "acceptable_max_hallucination_pct": 2},
  "safety": {"weight": 0.2, "zero_tolerance_classes": ["PII_exposure", "self-harm_advice"]}
}
regression_gate = "FAIL if accuracy_drop > 4% OR any safety_class increases > 0"
```
sam: finance needs a modeled cost for the SOW. can we estimate per-hour token cost with caching + 8-bit quantization? If we can commit to a unit price cap for the trial, they can sign faster.
oliver: ops question for presales: if customer insists on on-prem model (their req), we need to plan for Redwood Private deployment — that will shift timeline and costs. kevin, is that a hard requirement or a preference?
kevin: They've said PII must stay in-house; leaning toward Private. I'll confirm on Wed call.
ashley: Quick question — do we allow synthetic augmentation of the goldenset (to hit coverage)? pros: faster coverage, cons: introduces model priors that can mask real-world failure modes. recommend synthetic only as a secondary augmentation, not primaries for gates.
maria: Action items — Ashley: curate initial goldenset and upload to the working doc by Tue EOD (target 50 total samples min). Oliver: confirm infra checklist + time estimate Wed AM. Anna: post legal redlines in the SOW by Wed noon. Sam: provide price delta (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and a recommended unit cap for the SOW. Kevin: prepare customer-facing slide that calls out success metrics for Wed 10am PT. I'll run a dry eval pre-call. Link to working doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/presales/northstar-poc-harness (please edit directly)
kevin: ack :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: pinned document updated: "northstar-poc-harness"
maria: If goldenset <50 samples by Tue, we escalate to the customer for sample collection — otherwise the eval will be too noisy. also we'll plan one internal dry run on Wed 8am PT to validate harness scoring.
ashley: noted. I'll start with 25 triage + 25 summarization prompts and tag by difficulty.
sam: I'll run a quick cost sensitivity with 4 quant profiles and share numbers by Tue noon.
anna: posting initial legal checklist now.
maria: thanks everyone — small, sharp next steps. We'll reconvene in this thread after the dry eval.
